annotator: Codex, one annotator, with a second review of the evidence before any prediction. Not independent human consensus (round #2938, evaluation-set.json version 1).
boundaryRule: One event is one concrete announcement, study or event. Different software versions, experiments, dates or policy developments are separate events. Articles with no event label are not in the set.

source.name: Feeds of twelve technology and science publishers, October 2026 (round #2938). Link posts point to other sites, so the reports come from 27 hosts.
source.licence: The articles belong to their publishers. This repository holds only their URLs, dates, publishers and our labels.
source.attribution: Reports by the hosts of their URLs, mostly simonwillison.net, blog.cloudflare.com, blog.python.org, martinfowler.com, github.blog, daringfireball.net, jvns.ca, anthropic.com, sciencedaily.com, nature.com, sciencenews.org and phys.org. Labels by the zukhruf project.

weaknesses: Most events have one article: 217 articles, 209 events, 14 positive pairs.
The texts in the cache are elt captures of round #2947. A text that the runner fetches again is extracted with Readability, so it can differ.
